outcome: laboratory performance (turnaround time, sensitivity, specificity, predictive values)
cohort: Patients with non-COVID clinical presentations, those admitted to a multidisciplinary adult and paediatric non-COVID ICU, and medical staff in the non-COVID ICU at a large tertiary hospital in South Africa were included.
finding: The mobile PCR laboratory, staffed by non-laboratory healthcare workers, demonstrated high performance with a rapid turnaround time, high sensitivity and specificity, providing an effective solution for emergency COVID-19 diagnosis.
